title: HC-RAG: Evidence-Centric Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Heterogeneous Financial Filings
abstract: arXiv:2608.12335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial question answering over annual reports requires more than retrieving semantically similar passages. It often involves identifying relevant companies and fiscal years, locating standardized filing sections, collecting textual and tabular evidence, and checking answers against the original documents. Existing RAG systems, however, usually flatten long filings into unordered chunks, pay limited attention to the typed structure of financial reports, and use fixed text-table fusion strategies without considering query intent. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{HC-RAG}, a hierarchical cross-modal retrieval-augmented generation framework for evidence-centric financial QA. HC-RAG organizes filings into a typed financial evidence graph with documents, sections, text units, table units, and metadata nodes. translated_title: HC-RAG：面向异构财务文件的以证据为中心的检索增强生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12335v1 公告类型：新 摘要：针对年度报告的金融问答，不仅仅需要检索语义相似的段落。它通常涉及识别相关公司和财政年度，定位标准化的申报章节，收集文本和表格证据，并对照原始文档检查答案。然而，现有的RAG系统通常将冗长的申报文件扁平化为无序块，对财务报告的类型化结构关注有限，并且使用固定的文本-表格融合策略而不考虑查询意图。为解决这些限制，我们提出了\textbf{HC-RAG}，一个用于以证据为中心的金融问答的分层跨模态检索增强生成框架。HC-RAG将申报文件组织成具有文档、章节、文本单元、表格单元和元数据节点的类型化财务证据图。它通过文档-章节-单元路径检索证据，在共享检索空间中对齐文本和表格证据。
tldr: HC-RAG通过构建类型化财务证据图和分层跨模态检索，解决了财务申报文件中证据定位和文本-表格融合的挑战，实现了以证据为中心的金融问答。
en_tdlr: HC-RAG addresses the challenges of evidence localization and text-table fusion in financial filings by constructing a typed financial evidence graph and hierarchical cross-modal retrieval, enabling evidence-centric financial QA.
